name: Lost Lakes
description:
Backcountry camping adventures in Canada.  Erin & Jon, sharing a love for nature and wilderness. 
This channel is independent with no sponsors; it's made possible by you watching.

Contact: Being offline a lot, I never have a chance to check inboxes so they're turned off on FB and Insta.  The best and really only place to reach us is in YouTube comments...this is the first thing I try to keep up with.

Brands: We truly appreciate any interest in working with us but at this time we're just focused on making videos about nature.

name: Krikkos Adventure
description:
A motorcycle and a stubborn mind. Sometimes all it takes is a little courage to make dreams come true. 

Hi, I’m Krikko! 🏍️

I’ve ridden solo from Sweden to Nepal, and now I’m back home, ready for a new chapter of adventures.

I live for motorcycles, the great outdoors, and the thrill of exploring nature, camping and chasing freedom on two wheels.

I want to inspire all of you to step out of your comfort zones, face new challenges and pursue your dreams. Life's greatest rewards lie just outside your comfort zone.

Join me on my next journey, who knows where the road will take us, but I promise

name: Cody & Kellie
